notes:
- Comments open like a chat: A thread now fetches the newest page of replies instead of AniList's whole comment list, which is one request even on a post with nine hundred comments. The sheet opens at the newest message, an Older control walks back a page at a time, and a run of messages from one person loses the repeated face and name rather than the message. New replies that land while the thread is open are counted in a pill instead of stealing your place, and a long press on a comment's heart shows who liked it.
- Attach a photo from your device: The composer can put a picture from your gallery, camera roll or files into a comment. AniList has no upload endpoint of its own, so the app hands the file to catbox.moe - no account, no key - and writes the address it gets back as an embed, which Preview shows before you post. Photos too large for the host are refused with the reason, and a HEIC from an Android camera is converted to JPEG first so the other readers can actually open it.
- A GIF search in the composer: A GIF button opens a search inside the editor: results come from Openverse, an anonymous Creative Commons index that needs no key and no account, and tapping a tile drops it into your draft as an animated embed. Tenor's public key-free API was discontinued, so the Settings page takes your own Tenor key if you want the reaction catalogue instead - stored encrypted on the device, and never sent anywhere but Tenor.
- The format bar, rebuilt: Every marker AniList's comment markup actually accepts is now one tap away: underline, strikethrough, code, heading, block quote, lists, centring, a link, and the img, youtube and webm embeds. Controls are grouped - media first, then emphasis, then blocks - and the block ones write whole lines, because AniList only recognises an embed when the tag is the entire line. Replying to a comment gained a Quote action that puts the original behind quote marks with a blank line for your answer.
- Messages you can read, not just answer: Opening a message shows the conversation: both halves of the exchange, in the order they happened, newest at the bottom where a reply is written, with your own messages marked apart. AniList cannot be asked for a thread as a unit - the activity filter has no recipient - so the two sides are matched by the pair of ids and read together. Earlier messages load on demand.
- Centred and SVG bio images render: A bio that is a centred image - which is how AniList's own editor writes a banner, as ~~~img100%(https://...)~~~ - used to print as a centred sentence of markup. The parser now recognises an image inside a single-line centre span, keeping the width the author set. SVG images could not be decoded at all, so a server-drawn bio card failed silently; Coil now has an SVG decoder. Complex cards that nest images or fonts inside the SVG may still draw partly, which is a limit of that format on Android.
- No more black flash between pages: Tapping a navigation control twice in quick succession could flash the whole screen black. Both pages are mid-fade and slightly smaller than the screen for a few frames, and whatever sat behind them was the window, which the platform paints black. The navigation container is now painted with the app's own surface colour, so a cross-fade crosses a surface that matches the theme.
